statement: North Korea conducts at least one further ballistic missile launch between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-20.
resolution: True if South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff confirm a North Korean ballistic missile launch dated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-20, carried by at least two of Yonhap, Reuters, and Associated Press.
failure_condition: North Korea launches no ballistic missile during that window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Russian forces seize or detain at least one commercial vessel flagged in or operated from an EU member state between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: True if at least two of Reuters, Associated Press, and the flag state government confirm Russian seizure or detention of a named EU-flagged or EU-operated commercial vessel between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: Russia seizes or detains no EU-flagged or EU-operated commercial vessel during that window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog gains an entry naming Microsoft SharePoint Server or VMware vCenter Server with a date-added value between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: True if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry whose product field names SharePoint Server or vCenter Server with a dateAdded between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: The KEV catalog holds no SharePoint Server or vCenter Server entry with a dateAdded inside that range.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: The Electoral Commission of Zambia declares Hakainde Hichilema elected president in the first round, announced between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-20.
resolution: True if the ECZ formally declares Hichilema president-elect between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-20 with more than 50 percent of valid votes, avoiding a runoff.
failure_condition: The ECZ declares another candidate elected, announces a presidential runoff, or issues no first-round presidential declaration by 2026-08-20.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one magnitude 6.0 or greater earthquake located in Colombia with origin time between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: True if USGS ANSS ComCat lists an event of magnitude 6.0 or above whose place field names Colombia with origin time between 2026-08-13 and 2026-10-15.
failure_condition: ComCat lists no magnitude 6.0 or greater event in Colombia with origin time inside that window.
